items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: This was in Washington, D.C., where I met him

ctx.x: This was in Washington, D.C., where I met him, but he was mostly around Chicago and Ohio and Cleveland where he had all of his prostitutes. They called them whores at that time, or prostitutes, or ladies. Ladies of the evening. Ladies of the evening.
